thread:
alice.sec: Announcement: org policy update incoming. Starting 2026-07-01 we will block creation of new primitive IAM bindings (roles/owner, roles/editor) for users and service accounts. Purpose: remove blast radius and meet least-privilege audit requirements.

alice.sec: Timeline: announcement now; discovery/migration window = 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30; enforcement (deny new primitive bindings) = 2026-07-01 00:00 UTC. Post-enforcement automated cleanup begins 2026-08-01 for non-exempt projects.

alice.sec: Immediate actions for teams:
- Run quick scan: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner" or .role=="roles/editor")'`
- Replace primitive grants with least-privilege predefined roles or a narrow custom role.
- For SAs that legitimately need broad permissions, request a permission-boundary-based exception and provide a mitigation plan.

bob.dev: Clarifying Q: will existing primitive bindings be revoked on 7/1 or just block new ones?

alice.sec: Existing bindings remain until manual remediation; new creations/upgrades to primitive roles will be blocked. After 2026-08-01 we will start removing non-exempt bindings for low-risk projects.

deploy-bot: org-scan summary: scanned 410 projects 93 flagged 62 projects with primitive bindings; 21 service accounts exceed 50 permissions. CSV report posted to #security-scans.

carol.sre: We have legacy monitoring agents that use editor on a few SAs. Can SRE request an exception window?

alice.sec: Yes. Exceptions are temporary (max 90 days) and require an owner, mitigation (network/IP restrict or TTL), and a migration plan. Use the Security Exceptions form on Confluence and tag `exp:iam-primitive`.

dave.eng: I can script terraform diffs to propose least-privilege replacements and open PRs. Will coordinate with infra-automation.

alice.sec: Please do. If you submit automation, add `security-automation` tag so scans ignore in-flight PRs. We'll publish a migration playbook with TF examples and a checklist by EOD tomorrow.

eve.vpsec: This is a key control for our audit posture. Team leads: escalate blockers by 2026-06-20 so we can triage.

alice.sec: Detection hints: `git grep -n "roles/editor"` in infra repos, review `SetIamPolicy` audit logs for primitive grants in last 90 days, and scan terraform state for bindings. Reach out in-thread for help.

carol.sre: Acknowledged. We'll prioritize SRE-owned SAs and submit exception requests where needed.

alice.sec: Thanks all. Reminder: migration window ends 2026-06-30; enforcement starts 2026-07-01. We'll DM owners of flagged projects. :lock:
